component.name: meditor
component.summary: Markdown, Typst and LaTeX editor with live preview

description.p: meditor is a desktop and mobile editor for Markdown, Typst and LaTeX with a live, paginated preview, PDF export, tabs, session restore and a touch-first layout.
Documents stay on the device; files are opened and saved through the system dialogs. The LaTeX preview compiles through a configurable TeX Live endpoint.
